About the job
Application Deadline

September 30, 2026 (Early applications will be given preference)

Job Location

Gulshan-1, Dhaka

Number of Vacancies: 2

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for dynamic individuals having the following qualities.

Educational Requirements

* B. Sc. in Computer Science/ Electrical or Electronics Engineering (or similar) from any reputed university. 

Experience Requirements

* An ideal candidate should have 0-2 years of relevant work experience in C/C++ projects. (Freshers are encouraged to apply)
* If you don’t have the required work experience but have strong problem-solving ability and knowledge in the following area are also welcome to apply:
   * Micro-controllers
   * GPIO/SFR/SPI/I2C/UART
   * Interrupt handling
   * Memory mapped I/O
   * Processor low power state
   * ARM/STM32
   * FreeRTOS

Overview Of The Responsibilities

* Design, develop & maintain C/C++ based embedded system projects.
* Regularly communicating with US clients via email & phone call. 

Key Requirements

* Strong problem solving & critical thinking ability. Candidates will be tested.
* Ability to write moderately bug free code without IDE. Candidates will be tested.
* Design, develop & maintain C/C++ for embedded system project.
* Adherent to teamwork and always represent team in work and achievement.
* Good reading and writing skill in English.
* Excellent communication skill in English.
* Follows industry best practices for coding. 

Nice To Have Requirements

* Experience with various sensors like temperature, light, humidity and accelerometer.
* Experience with RTOS.
* Principles of electronics relevant to micro-controllers.
* Good knowledge on network communication such as TCP, UDP etc.
* Basics of version control system (check in, check out, branching, merging etc.), preferably git.
* Comfortable using C concepts like array, null terminated string, pointer, bitwise operation, type casting, low level memory management etc.
* Good knowledge on object-oriented programming.
* Follows industry best practices for coding and software development.
* Good listening and speaking skill in English. 

What's in it for you?

* Very Competitive Salary with Excellent Career Opportunity in a Focused & Stable organization.
* Overseas Tour with Opportunity to work with global companies.
* Most importantly a friendly work environment with opportunity to learn from a number of highly skilled mentors.
* Flexible office hours.
* Weekend: Saturday and Sunday. 

How would you apply?

If you believe you are the right candidate, then send your CV to career@relisource.com with this exact line as email's subject“ESE_CS_15032025”bySeptember 30, 2026.

IMPORTANT:Resume attached without above subject line will not be processed. Your CV must include your photograph.
